title: Bato dela Rosa's fellow PMAer Lacson 'praying' for his peaceful arrest

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo Lacson said he is praying that the arrest of Sen. Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa, his fellow former chief of the Philippine National Police (PNP), will be carried out “peacefully, without violence or tragedy.” “He has his faults, as we all do. But whatever accusations he faces, he is entitled to due process, a fundamental right guaranteed to every Filipino, and for that matter, to every human being,” Lacson said. The government on Friday placed a ₱50-million bounty on Dela Rosa. The PNP gave its former chief one week to surrender and face trial at the International […]...
